title: ASC 820 Fair Value Support - Canton Coin at DTCC Contract Signing
conclusionSummary: Establishes the per-coin fair value of Canton Coin at the 2026-01-15 DTCC milestone-contract signing date for use as noncash consideration. Concludes fair value of 0.0033 USD per coin (Level 3) from informal OTC secondary-market evidence, and rejects the 0.0005 USD/CC published network fee-reference price as a non-exit-price fee-conversion parameter. Illustrative data; the OTC input is thin and self-reported and the input-selection judgment requires valuation-reviewer approval.
